purpose: Maintain exactly 15 active candidates + append-only cemetery. Replacement only when repair budget exhausted AND credible replacement exists in reservoir. No count inflation.

entries.name: Fail-Run Membrane
entries.cause: r⁴ physical constraint (flow rate ∝ radius⁴). V1+V2 both failed at clinically feasible diameters. Mechanism infeasible — no repair attempted.
entries.lesson: Hagen-Poiseuille r⁴ scaling means small-diameter fail-run membranes cannot deliver clinically required drainage. Avoid membrane-based passive drainage scaling strategies.

entries.name: Energy-Neutral Micro-Assistant
entries.cause: CSF kinetic energy harvesting measured at 0.62 nW. Physics measurement falsifies the mechanism. 0.62 nW is insufficient for any useful micro-assistant function.
entries.lesson: CSF kinetic energy is too low (sub-nW) to power implantable micro-electronics. Avoid CSF-kinetic-harvesting architectures. This kill has implications for P-15 — P-15 must use a different harvesting mechanism (piezoelectric, thermoelectric, or other) or it is also falsified.
entries.cross_reference: P-15 R309 action plan step 1 mandates cross-check against this cemetery entry.

replacement_reservoir.description: Existing candidates that could be promoted to active portfolio if a Phase C candidate fails its repair budget. NOT new inventions — these are existing candidates that were previously considered but not promoted.

reservoir_candidates.name: Biofilm-Resistant Living-Surface
reservoir_candidates.notes: Originally killed for being concept-level, not mechanism-level. If P-17 (biohybrid endothelial monolayer) fails cell-biology cross-check, R-SC-05 may be a credible replacement IF its mechanism can be specified to falsifiable detail.

reservoir_candidates.name: Distributed Micro-Shunt Mesh Swarm
reservoir_candidates.original_round: R268 (Level 2 survivor, downgraded R269 architecture occupied, control law unspecified)
reservoir_candidates.notes: Originally downgraded because control law was unspecified. If a Phase C candidate fails on physics grounds, R-SC-10 may be a credible replacement IF its control law can be specified to falsifiable detail.

reservoir_candidates.name: Osmotic Valve
reservoir_candidates.original_round: R273 (DOWNGRADED to WATCH — US20020087111 functional equivalent found)
reservoir_candidates.notes: Likely NOT credible replacement due to prior art threat. Listed for completeness; not actively considered unless prior art can be differentiated.

reservoir_candidates.name: Venturi Self-Powering
credible_replacement_for: P-15 if P-08 cross-check fails AND Venturi physics can be independently verified
reservoir_candidates.notes: Originally WATCH due to physics risk. May be credible replacement for P-15 IF Venturi physics can be modeled and verified independently (simulator + published measurement).

replacement_reservoir.rule: Reservoir candidates may only be promoted after (a) the active candidate's repair budget is exhausted, (b) the reservoir candidate's previous kill/downgrade reason has been addressed, and (c) the promotion is documented with provenance (Article XXXI).

trigger_conditions: Active candidate's repair budget (1 attempt) exhausted.
Second failure observed under same pre-registered criterion.
selection_process: Search reservoir for candidates whose original kill/downgrade reason is no longer disqualifying.
Verify reservoir candidate can be specified to falsifiable mechanism detail.
Promote to active portfolio with new ID (e.g., P-18 if P-05 killed and R-SC-10 promoted).
Reservoir candidate inherits full R309 completion pipeline (not just manufacturing).
forbidden: Inventing a new candidate to inflate the count.
Promoting a reservoir candidate without addressing its original kill/downgrade reason.
Skipping the completion pipeline for a promoted candidate.
Reviving a cemetery entry without constitutional waiver.
